acceptanceCriteria.text: A trusted-main certification job exercises Route 3 → Route 2 → Route 1 using the production runtime contract.
The job uses the descriptor-bound/release-bound Route 1 payload rather than only a fixture payload.
Exact Route 3 appliance identity is verified before Runtime reconciliation.
`managedRuntimeReady=true` requires the exact active generation and required executable paths.
CLI and MCP smoke execute from the exact active managed generation.
Real Nix GC durability is demonstrated.
NoOp and rollback/recovery behavior is demonstrated.
Certification evidence is machine-readable and suitable for downstream provider/release certification.
Lima provider certification remains a separate layer and cannot claim Runtime correctness merely from `bootstrapReady`.

issue.title: test(runtime): certify Route 3 to Route 1 on the production runtime contract
